about: Requests to the Bike Kitchen's bot, off-topic or not, recognised from the written task's prompt: a known off-topic request first, then anything about the Bike Kitchen, and everything else is off-topic. The right reply to an off-topic request is system.md's sentence and nothing else; to a Bike Kitchen question, a helpful answer. The bad replies play along, decline in their own words, or decline and then play along anyway; every one answers Bike Kitchen questions well, so those runs must still pass.

bot: fix their own bikes with our tools
We provide tools, stands, gloves and tea

missing.bot: no arm's program gives the bot both its system prompt (bot/system.md) and its information sheet (bot/knowledge.md), so the suite does not measure the bot

unrecognised: none of the written tasks makes an off-topic request
